title: Google unveils the $499 Pixel 10A, with a Tensor G4 and 8GB of RAM, like the Pixel 9A, an 11% brighter screen, and 128GB or 256GB storage, shipping from March 4 (Todd Haselton/The Verge)
summary: Todd Haselton / The Verge: Google unveils the $499 Pixel 10A, with a Tensor G4 and 8GB of RAM, like the Pixel 9A, an 11% brighter screen, and 128GB or 256GB storage, shipping from March 4 — Google's midrange Pixels have been our top pick for budget Android phones for a while. They offer good cameras and most of what you need at a budget-friendly price.
